issues.title: Stop compressing hash-join keys in compressed materialization
issues.hypothesis: Compressed materialization (CM) compresses both join-key columns of a single-condition comparison join. CompressComparisonJoin puts the probe key in probe_compress_bindings, which inserts __internal_compress_integral_* projections on the probe side. Those projections block the Bloom-filter pushdown into the probe scan. E0006 only plumbed min/max and key-set ranges through them, and E0008, which pushed the BF through, was retired. They also add decompress/compress pairs (q13: a 0.21s CPU decompress projection on 15M rows, then a compress). Measured on the current best with SET disabled_optimizers='compressed_materialization', JSON profile of raw q09: latency 542→335ms, CPU 3.69→2.21s. The o_orderkey=l_orderkey join drops from 1.60s to 0.73s because the orders probe scan now gets the BF and emits 2.94M rows instead of 15M. The lineitem/part join also drops from 0.54s to 0.41s, and the 0.12s compress projection disappears. Alternating warm runs of the raw query: q09 ~484→~418ms (-14%), q03 ~204→~179ms (-12%). q13, q18 and q05 were unchanged within noise. That is the whole-CM upper bound; join keys are the part that blocks the BF.
issues.plan: In src/optimizer/compressed_materialization/compress_comparison_join.cpp, CompressedMaterialization::CompressComparisonJoin: remove (or gate off) the block at lines ~57-85 that compresses both join-condition columns generically and adds lhs_colref.binding to probe_compress_bindings. Every condition then goes through GetReferencedBindings, so key columns are never compressed. Build-side payload columns are still compressed, and the probe side is still left alone. UpdateComparisonJoinStats then has nothing to update for the keys, which is fine. Step 1: measure raw q09 and q03, not wrapped in count(*), because the wrapper changes the plan. Alternate runs with and without the change. Discard the first 2-3 runs of each dbe-tool sql process, because warm-up made a false -30% on q05. Step 2: if the key-only variant gets clearly less than SET disabled_optimizers='compressed_materialization' gives on q09/q03, try variant B: return early from CompressComparisonJoin (no join CM at all; aggregate/order/distinct CM unchanged). Keep whichever is faster across the full bench. Check that EXPLAIN for q09 shows the BF on the orders scan and that q13 still uses the perfect RIGHT hash join (its keys become BIGINT instead of UINTEGER).
issues.expected_gain: q09 -10..-14%, q03 -8..-12%; possibly q05/q07/q08 and q13 (no decompress/compress pair) a few %. Geomean about -2%.
issues.generality: Helps any join whose probe key would have been compressed by CM: integer FK joins where the build side is large enough to pass the CM thresholds. Removing the key projections lets the runtime BF, min/max and perfect-HJ filters reach the probe scan directly, and saves a projection per key. Could get slower: joins with very large builds, where 4-byte compressed keys made the hash table smaller and more cache-friendly, and memory-bound or spilling joins. The payload compression that matters most for memory is kept.
issues.risk: Low-medium. The change only removes an optimization, so correctness risk is minimal: uncompressed keys go through the same code path as joins below the CM thresholds. The main risk is performance on large-build joins without a selective BF, and the perfect HJ / exact-BF gates seeing BIGINT keys instead of compressed ones; check q13 and q18.

dispatch: Stop compressing hash-join keys in compressed materialization
output.memory:
## Memory (gen2)

## State
- gen1 (r1-r16): accepted E0001 JoinDependent rule order (q19), E0002 contains() selectivity (q09), E0003 perfect HJ RIGHT (q13), E0005 BF first key multi-key HJ (q09), E0006 key-set range filter through compress projs (q18), E0007 exact bitmap BF, E0011 semi-join estimate, E0012 OR-of-ranges mask, E0014 FSST simple decode + substring prefilter (q13), E0016 DELIM_GET-build BF (q22 -20%). Best 1.281x.
- gen2 r1 DISPATCHED: stop compressing hash-join keys in CM (compress_comparison_join.cpp), with variant B no join CM at all.
- Claude auto-memory (~/.claude/.../memory) holds results from a PREVIOUS evolve run on this codebase. Treat them as strong measured priors, not landed code.

## Key finding gen2 r1: compressed materialization (CM) on join keys
- SET disabled_optimizers='compressed_materialization' on raw q09: latency 542→335ms profiled, CPU 3.69→2.21s. The orders-probe join drops 1.60→0.73s because the BF reaches the orders scan (15M→2.94M rows). Alternating warm runs: q09 -14%, q03 -12%; q13/q18/q05 neutral.
- E0008 (push the BF THROUGH the compress proj) got only -3.9% official. Removing the compression instead also removes the projections. If the key-only variant underdelivers, try no join CM at all.
- If this lands: re-check whether CM on aggregates/order (compress_aggregate.cpp, compress_order.cpp) also costs time. q09 has a 0.12s compress_string_uhugeint(n_name) projection feeding a 175-group agg.

## Measurement lessons
- dbe-tool sql: the first 2-3 runs of a query in a process are slow (warm-up). A "-30% on q05" was pure warm-up. Always alternate ON/OFF/ON/OFF.
- Do NOT wrap in count(*): it changes the plan (q09 raw 480ms vs 380ms wrapped). Use a temp view + `from v limit 1`.
- The JSON profile has latency and cpu_time. Extract with regexp_extract_all over read_text; fields come in the order timing, cardinality, name per operator.
- Retirements on templates the change can't touch are noise. Rerunning them is a cheap, high-value dispatch.

## Profile snapshot (gen2 start): q18 576, q13 561, q09 541, q05 283, q04 244, q17 236, q08 230, q03 208, q16 192, q07 190, q14 165, q19 157, q22 151, q02 86. Geomean 236ms.
- q13: inner agg on c_custkey 15M rows → 1.5M groups 2.75s CPU; orders scan 1.99s CPU; decompress proj 0.21s.
- q18: second lineitem scan emits 12.1M rows despite an IN-list of 111 keys (an optional zonemap-only filter). Join only 0.06s. Small target.
- q05: plan identical with CM on/off; lineitem scan 0.9s CPU with BF.

## Dead / exhausted
- FSST DecompressVector path: enable_fsst_vectors is off by default, so the scan never emits FSST vectors and DecompressVector is not hot. No dict_fsst segments in the DB (VARCHAR columns are FSST or Dictionary only). Candidate dropped.
- HJ prefetch, agg run-collapse, in-place finalize, FSST heap reuse, dictionary filter, scan filter cost ordering, early HT grow, sparse perfect HJ, bitpacking select, BF on sparse perfect HJ: ~0% or worse.
- Large perfect HA: real q13 gain, but the official bench flags q18 each time (DEAD).
- E0010 distinct HT partitioned on group hash (q16 -7.4%), E0008 exact BF through CM offset (-3.9%): retired; superseded if CM key compression goes.

## Next candidates
1. (after r1) CM on aggregates/order: measure per-operator cost of compress projections on q09/q13/q18.
2. The DELIM BF gate for IS NOT DISTINCT FROM conds (q17 RIGHT on the agg side; q18 RIGHT_SEMI).
3. q18 IN-list optional filter → evaluate per row when the key set is small (12M→~800 rows emitted), small gain.
4. q04/q08/q07 not analysed yet.

## Codebase facts
- CM: src/optimizer/compressed_materialization.cpp dispatches to compressed_materialization/compress_{aggregate,comparison_join,distinct,order}.cpp. Join key compression is the probe_compress_bindings block (single condition, not DELIM). Release thresholds JOIN_BUILD_CARDINALITY_THRESHOLD etc. are in the header.
- Rule registration order: src/optimizer/optimizer.cpp. Scan-filter cardinality: RelationStatisticsHelper::InspectTableFilter.
- ColumnData::Filter = Scan + ColumnSegment::FilterSelection (dense mask and substring prefilter in column_segment.cpp).
- OptionalFilter is zonemap only. SelectivityOptionalFilter evaluates rows (the BF uses it); key-set ranges and IN-list are plain OptionalFilter.
- BF gate: CanUseBloomFilter (physical_hash_join.cpp ~865). build_side_has_filter is set in join_filter_pushdown_optimizer.cpp ~331. Exact BF: TrySetExactBloomFilter, 128 bits/key cap.
- Perfect HJ: perfect_hash_join_executor.cpp CanDoPerfectHashJoin. Perfect HA: plan_aggregate.cpp.
- FSST scan decode: src/storage/compression/fsst.cpp FSSTScanState::DecompressStrings/DecodeString.
- Noise thresholds: q16 ~7.9%, q18 ~5%, q13 ~14%, q09 ~8.6%, q14 ~5.1%; q04/q08/q17 ±5-15%. Implementer-measured gains are often 2x the official ones.
- Testing BF: compare against SET disabled_optimizers='join_filter_pushdown'.
- Budget is tight (~$4/session): read memory and the issues, run one or two targeted experiments, then dispatch.
